example_sentences_in_bangla: বাবা তার মেয়েকে চাঁদ বলে ডাকেন।
example_sentences_in_english: Father calls his daughter his moon.
This flower is my cherished one.
history: References the famous Bengali song 'আমার সোনা চাঁদের কণা', often used in folk and popular culture to express deep affection.
note: Commonly used in spoken and literary Bengali to denote something or someone dearly loved, evoking imagery of the moon's beauty.
